note: Kapital Bank's tariff schedule for banking services for individuals (effective 25 July 2026, its tariffs page's spreadsheet): its account opening and maintenance section charges nothing for keeping a current account; opening one is free for a resident and 20 manats for a non-resident, which the game doesn't count.

sources.title: Kapital Bank, Tariff Schedule for Banking Services for Individuals (effective 25 July 2026), linked from https://www.kapitalbank.az/en/tariffs

Opening a current account (for residents) - In branch or via Birbank mobile app | free ... Opening a current account (for non-residents) [1] | 20 AZN
